summary: Design agent completed Low-Level Design for NFR-PERF-002 (Issue #27) — Enforce <2ms raycast latency in 500-brick scenes via instrumented timing. LLD covers: module architecture (bvhManager.ts MODIFIED, raycastEngine.ts MODIFIED, performanceMonitor.ts MODIFIED, useRaycast.ts MODIFIED, raycastLatency.test.ts NEW), interface contracts (BvhManagerInterface, RaycastEngineInterface, PerformanceMonitorInterface, UseRaycastReturn), data models (RaycastSample, RaycastStats, BvhState), 4 sequence diagrams (happy path instrumented, production stripped, incremental rebuild, CI failure), BVH init algorithm (idempotent monkey-patch), instrumented raycast wrapper (performance.now() with import.meta.env.PROD guard), p95 computation algorithm, speedup measurement (naive vs BVH), 8 test cases (T-PERF-PERF-002-01 through -08), error handling (7 conditions), security considerations (timing side-channel, memory exhaustion, prototype pollution, brickId validation), performance budget (p95 <2ms, speedup >=5x, BVH build <=50ms, incremental rebuild <=5ms), CI integration (Vitest config + GitHub Actions step), and 4 open questions. Draft PR #54 is open on branch feature/27-nfr-perf-002-design awaiting Gate 6a human design review before merge to main. Area determined as frontend (pure client-side SPA).
